groups.saying_opens: لا يزال هذا الأمر عزيزا منيعا ظاهرا

notes: Saying 2 («فقلت لأبي يا أبتاه ... قال: كلهم من قريش») is a first-person narrative whose narrator is unnamed: needs ruling (rule 11); the father is read as its one link by relation
The Imam-like «يزيد بن سنان» opens the chain as the source of the hadith collection, then speaks as «قال: حدثنا» (rule 5)
The dashes after «كلهم» hold the garbled section of the text; the text is not altered
